name: aosp-nav
description: go-to-definition and completion across all android java modules

commands.title: Select Java Source Roots by Module

aosp-nav.androidRoot.description: Explicit AOSP root path. If null, auto-detected from the opened file path

aosp-nav.excludeJars.description: Regex patterns matched against jar file name AND module name (appended to defaults)

aosp-nav.excludePaths.description: Substring keywords matched against the jar path relative to .intermediates/ (appended to defaults)

aosp-nav.excludeGlobs.description: Regex patterns matched against the path relative to .intermediates/ (appended to defaults). Anchor with ^ for top-level dirs, e.g. ^external/cronet/

aosp-nav.excludeMerge.description: append = user exclusion lists are added after defaults; replace = defaults discarded

aosp-nav.settingsScope.description: Where java.project.referencedLibraries and the Gradle/Maven importer switches are written. workspace (default): .vscode/settings.json inside the repo, no impact on other Java projects; global: user settings, shared across windows but absolute jar paths pollute non-AOSP Java projects. A switch you set back to true yourself is always left alone

aosp-nav.java.sourceRoots.description: Hand-written source root additions (relative to the AOSP root, or absolute), merged on top of the module-based roots. Module roots come from the soong build index; an AOSP-root window selects frameworks/base/core/java and frameworks/base/services/core by default and injects every first-party source root they own (written to aosp-nav.java.sourceRootModules). Injecting sourcePaths disables jdt.ls per-file source inference for modules outside the injected roots. Pushed into the running language server, no window reload needed.

aosp-nav.java.sourceRootModules.description: Module directories (relative to the AOSP root) picked via 'AOSP: Select Java Source Roots by Module'. An AOSP-root window with no written selection gets frameworks/base/core/java and frameworks/base/services/core persisted here by default (every first-party source root they own is injected — on a real tree 16 roots instead of 2). Subdirectory windows keep the auto selection of production modules under the folder (tests/demos/samples/commercial excluded). Writing an explicit list (even an empty one) disables the auto selection. Third-party roots (external/, vendor/, ...) are offered as a separate opt-in step. Pushed into the running language server, no window reload needed.

aosp-nav.cpp.enabled.description: C/C++ navigation via clangd: point clangd at the soong compdb when it exists, otherwise extract compile flags per opened file from module_bp_cc_deps.json (Android.bp as last resort) and write a managed compile_commands.json. Requires the llvm-vs-code-extensions.vscode-clangd extension.

aosp-nav.cpp.restartDebounceMs.description: Debounce before restarting clangd after clangd.arguments actually changed. Entries added later are reloaded by clangd without a restart, so this only applies to argument changes.

aosp-nav.cpp.suggestClangdPath.description: Offer to set clangd.path to the AOSP prebuilt clangd (prebuilts/clang/host/linux-x86/clang-*/bin/clangd). The extension bundles no binary; the setting is only written after an explicit click.

aosp-nav.cpp.curatedIncludes.description: Include directories (relative to the AOSP root, skipped when missing) added only by the Android.bp fallback tier, which cannot resolve every header_libs edge.

aosp-nav.cpp.headerLibDepth.description: Maximum depth when resolving header_libs inside the same Android.bp (fallback tier only; tree-wide header_libs lookup is not implemented).
